referents.why: Feminine singular הִוא agrees with its predicate אֶצְבַּע ('finger') in a verbless clause, but the finger is the predicate, not the referent. The referent is the gnat plague just wrought, which is not among the candidates.
referents.category: demonstrative in verbless clause, referent not a candidate

referents.why: Masculine plural object 'them' matches the masculine plural 'magicians' (w3), the speakers of the turn just before, whom Pharaoh would not heed.
referents.category: object pronoun for the prior speakers

referents.why: Implied subject of the refusal 'he did not listen' is Pharaoh; masculine singular agrees, and a heart cannot listen. The builder's 'heart' (w11) is the subject of the hardening in cl2, the wrong referent for the listening.
referents.category: implied subject of a refusal, builder took the body part

links.why: ka'asher 'just as' before a saying clause ('he had said Yahweh') nested in the prepositional role. The saying is the earlier word the refusal fulfils.
cl0 is the magicians' opening speech, earlier in the verse. cl3 is a qatal joined to cl2 by a separate waw, so it does not continue the narrative from cl0, and the link runs against the line.
cl1 is the content of the magicians' speech, not a narrative event. The next event on the narrative line after cl0 is cl2.
links.category: narrative link from inside a speech

links.why: cl2 is wayyiqtol with fused waw and continues the narrative line from the nearest clause not inside a speech, which is cl0.
cl0 is the magicians' saying and cl1 ('[is] the finger of God') is what was said. The said clause is embedded in the speaking.
Separate waw before the qatal לֹא שָׁמַע is 'and' (not fused into the verb), joining the refusal to the hardening.

groups.why: The magicians (w3, masculine plural) speak to Pharaoh (w5). cl0 frames the speech and cl1 is what was said.
groups.category: speech with frame, content, sender and addressee

cant_tell.what: the earlier word of the LORD that 'just as he had said Yahweh' fulfils
cant_tell.why: The saying is not among the verses given. cl4 is kept as the comparison, but its source lies outside the window.
